name: Falls Metal Fabricators & Industrial Services, LLC
old_description: Falls Metal Fabricators and Industrial Services, formerly Falls Sheet Metal Works Inc., has been in business since 1939. Since then, we have built a solid reputation for quality service, consistently meeting and exceeding the expectations of our customers. We have the capacity to produce high-quality metal products from prototype through high-volume production runs. about:
Falls Metal Fabricators & Industrial Services operates from Akron, Ohio, where it has been in business since 1939. The company traces its roots to Falls Sheet Metal Works Inc., the name under which it originally opened. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named in available sources.

The shop provides metal fabrication services spanning prototype development through high-volume production runs. Its engineering staff assists with design for manufacturability, while experienced production personnel—including journeymen who have completed nationally recognized apprentice programs—handle welding, forming, and assembly. Typical output includes industrial guard rails, machine components, kitchen counter tops, and complex welded assemblies. The facility is described as equipped with modern equipment and technology, though specific machine models are not listed.

The company serves customers needing custom metalwork across industrial, commercial, and residential projects. Examples cited in its own materials range from heavy industrial guard rails and machinery to residential kitchen counter tops. No specific industry sectors or named clients are identified beyond these product categories.

Falls Metal emphasizes its workforce credentials—journeymen with formal apprenticeship training—as a key differentiator, along with an engineering team focused on cost-effective design. The firm states it has built a reputation for quality service over more than 70 years, aiming to meet or exceed customer expectations on every project.
